name: Jonas Fitzgerald
original_name: ジョナス・フィッツジェラルド
source:
"Let's see how long that human body of yours can last."

One of the five nobles governing the Berezinsky domain, he represents the bloodline of Lord Ruthven. He is the youngest among the five and the last vampire to join them. His duty is to maintain order between humans and vampires, even if it means turning his blade against his own kind.

[Translated from [url=https://x.com/WitchB_otomate/status/2016798471081382302/]Twitter[/url]]
